merturl4576-unflat-unflat.description: Use when a website or landing page looks flat - one background color across the whole page, sections and cards floating on the same plane, no depth, no ground, no light. Also use when asked to add depth, texture or atmosphere, ground a site, frame its sections, make a background less boring, or to "unflat" a page. For marketing and content pages built with plain CSS, Tailwind, CSS modules or CSS-in-JS; not for app dashboards.
